title: Construction Equipment Telematics Analytics

label: For "Construction Equipment Telematics Analytics": Use equipment telemetry to estimate utilisation, idle time, fuel use and maintenance needs by machine type and site so fleets are planned and serviced better, without scoring operators. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Operator ranking.
